name: Aggressive — weak market
notes: RSI(14) under 30 is the textbook oversold line -- by then the drop is already priced, so this buys a small cover over a short window rather than staying uncovered.

name: Aggressive — calm market
notes: RSI(14) over 30 is most of the time, so this holds the smallest, shortest cover of the six bands and accepts the most risk in between. An RSI reading of exactly 30 matches neither band -- a known, accepted gap, not a bug.
